notes: MLS Assist v1.33 — Security hardening. The copy-every-visit bridge (which can return chart/visit data) is now gated exactly like the main MLS bridge: it only accepts requests from the trusted MLS app (mlsscribe.com over HTTPS, source 'mls-app') and posts results/progress back only to that trusted active origin — never broadcast to other pages. An untrusted or non-MLS page can no longer trigger it or read its results. No functional change to copy-every-visit, the Mode C procedure grab, the scribe, or any prior feature. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
